notes.text:
Track #288 review note — `/code-review 308 high`, post-merge into `kb/track-288`.

The removal itself verified clean: every removed symbol (`actionsFiles`, `installActions`,
`triggerProfiles`, `ACTIONS_PROFILE`, `workflowAllowedTools`, `checkActions`,
`hkbInstallForActions`, `mode: 'trigger'`, `a.remote`, `attempt.remote`) has no dangling
reference anywhere in `src/`, `test/`, `types/`, `scripts/`, `skills/`, `templates/`, `bin/`;
no helper went dead; `checkWorkerPermissions`'s only caller matches its new signature; the
`removedInitFlag` guard fires before anything is written.

Four findings, none fixed yet — #291 is live on `src/dispatch.js` and `src/board.js` right now,
so 1 and 4 wait for the root's own verify pass on the track branch:

1. `src/dispatch.js:648` — dropping `a.remote` from the "nothing local to inspect" branch means an
   existing run record carrying `remote: true` (pidless, no job, host = the claiming laptop) now
   falls through to line 676 and is marked `crashed` 180s in. After an operator deletes the
   `claude-action` profile, as the new `loadBoard` error tells them to, a still-running Actions
   worker's attempt is reclaimed and its card re-claimed — two workers on one PR. Those records are
   durable (they live in run comments) and no migration covers them.
2. `skills/kanban/references/protocol.md:127` — the attempts row (line 39) was updated but tick
   step 2 still documents `remote` attempts twice. `skills/kanban/SKILL.md:237` still names Actions
   as a supervisor where protocol.md's exit-code section now says `launchd`.
3. `test/dispatch.test.js` — `test/actions.test.js` held the only test of `hkb dispatch --profiles`
   and the `dispatchable` gate, and it was deleted whole. The PR keeps that feature deliberately;
   nothing in the suite asserts it any more.
4. `src/board.js:502` — the `mode: "trigger"` refusal throws from `loadBoard`, which `makeContextAt`
   and `init()` both call, so `hkb doctor` and `hkb init` — the two repair verbs — also exit 2 on an
   affected board. Hooks degrade via `loadBoardSafe`; the CLI has no equivalent, so hand-editing
   board.json is the only way out.

residual_risk: The card asked for a new pure function with a test in src/model.js; the two new pure functions live where their siblings do instead - removedInitFlag beside resolveProfiles in src/init.js, the trigger refusal beside the effort/tools refusals in loadBoard (src/board.js). Both are exported and tested (test/harness.test.js, test/profiles.test.js). Nothing new went into src/model.js; only a stale comment was dropped there.

hkb show no longer prints the off-host marker for a HISTORICAL attempt row carrying remote:true. Such rows can still exist in old run comments; they now render as an ordinary attempt. Judged right (the field is gone from the type and nothing writes it) but it is a silent change to how old history reads.

wiki-stamp --all was used, so the 20 pages #289 left stale by file hash are now stamped at this commit too. Their content was checked only where it mentioned the runner; a page asserting something else about src/*.js that #289's JSDoc pass changed would now be stamped fresh without having been re-read line by line.
CI has not run on this branch. The four jobs #289 added (test on 22/24, smoke on 22/26) are unexercised here beyond the local lint/test/smoke.
docs/wiki/features/harness-profiles is still an unwritten planned page; its plan summary was updated to five profiles, but nothing yet asserts the removal in a drafted page of its own.
The base is kb/track-288, which already contains #289. PR #308 targets that branch, so Closes #290 will not auto-close - the track branch's own PR into main is what lands it.
verification: npm install (devDeps: tsc was not present in this throwaway worktree)
npm run lint - node --check loop + tsc --noEmit, green
npm test - 1107 pass, 0 fail (was 941 tests with 4 failing files mid-change: doctor, harness, profiles, release)
npm run smoke - packs, installs and runs the tarball; it caught the templates/actions/ entry still listed in scripts/smoke-pack.mjs's content checks, now removed
node bin/hkb.js init --with-actions - exit 2 with the ADR-006 message
node .repolore/scripts/wiki-check.mjs - all 22 pages fresh, no plan drift
node .repolore/scripts/wiki-stamp.mjs --all, then again on the two pages covering scripts/smoke-pack.mjs after the second commit

results.summary:
The GitHub Actions runner is gone whole: templates/actions/ and this repo's two generated workflows, actionsFiles/installActions/hkbInstallForActions/triggerProfiles/ACTIONS_PROFILE and the --with-actions path in src/init.js, the claude-action profile in DEFAULT_PROFILES, mode:'trigger' everywhere (the trigger tail of spawnWorker, the remote branch of the reclaim loop, every a.remote and spawned.remote read in src/dispatch.js, attempt.remote in types/hkb.d.ts, the "off-host" marker in hkb show), checkActions and workflowAllowedTools in src/doctor.js, and test/actions.test.js.

Two things speak instead of failing silently: `hkb init --with-actions` exits 2 via removedInitFlag (a pure exported function in src/init.js, called first thing in init() before anything is written; it matches ANY flag name containing "actions", so --actions and --no-actions answer the same way) with a message naming ADR-006 and `hkb up`; and loadBoard now refuses a board.json naming mode:'trigger', exit 2, naming the profile and telling the operator to delete it and re-point its cards.

Kept deliberately, do not remove in a later node: --profiles on hkb dispatch (a host says which profiles it launches; the comments that used to justify it by Actions were rewritten, not deleted), manual attempts and their heartbeat-only liveness, heartbeat:'comment', and actionsAnnotation/emitAnnotations in src/doctor.js (those are about running `hkb doctor` INSIDE CI, not about dispatching from it, and this repo's own test.yml/release.yml still run on Actions).

Note for A3 (which moves tasks.js/lock.js): neither file was touched, and no import in either changed. checkWorkerPermissions(ctx, sink) lost its third injectable {read, exists} parameter, which only the deleted workflow branch used; the test callers were updated.

Two deliberate deviations from the card's Done-when grep, both defensible: (1) docs/harnesses.md and README.md keep a short migration table naming claude-action, --with-actions and mode trigger. That is the only place they survive outside the history files, and it exists so a user with the old setup finds the answer rather than a silent removal (value 5: every error says what to do next). (2) docs/local-first.md still describes what to remove, because it is the plan-of-record for this very card and rewriting it would falsify the record. Also, the card's grep pattern for a dotted "remote" word cannot return clean either way: cfg?.remote in src/gc.js and src/lock.js is the GIT remote name, unrelated, and stays.
